The '''Andorra national basketball team''' is the national team of [[Andorra]]. The national team has always represented in the [[EuroBasket Division C]]. It also takes part well in [[Games of the Small States of Europe]].

==History==
Despite not joining [[FIBA]] until 1988, Andorra made its debut in the [[Basketball at the 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe|1985 Games of the Small States of Europe]] where, after winning their first game ever against [[Luxembourg national basketball team|Luxembourg]], finished in the last position after losing to [[Cyprus national basketball team|Cyprus]] and [[Malta national basketball team|Malta]].

Andorra would come back to competition in 1989, where it achieved its first great success by winning the tournament at the [[1989 Games of the Small States of Europe]], played in Cyprus after beating [[Cyprus national basketball team|the home team]] in the final by 54–52.<ref>[http://basketball.org.cy/el/page/national-team?id=3&slug=%CE%B5%CE%B8%CE%BD%CE%B9%CE%BA%CE%AE-%CE%B1%CE%BD%CE%B4%CF%81%CF%8E%CE%BD&year=1989 Cyprus results of the 1989 GSSE at the Cyprus Basketball Federation]</ref> In 1991, the team could not repeat success and ended in the fourth position of the [[1991 Games of the Small States of Europe|1991 edition]], that Andorra hosted.

In 1994, Andorra would make its debut at the [[FIBA Promotion Cup]]. In its [[1994 European Promotion Cup for Men|first participation]], the team ended in the seventh position after losing all its five games.

Four years later, the team conquered its first Promotion Cup title by ending unbeaten in the [[1998 European Promotion Cup for Men|1998 edition]]. Andorra would repeat success in [[2000 European Promotion Cup for Men]] for starting to be one of the top teams in the Promotion Cup, later renamed as European Championship for Small Countries.

In 2009, Andorra achieved the bronze medal at the [[Basketball at the 2009 Games of the Small States of Europe|2009 Games of the Small States of Europe]] by taking advantage to [[Iceland men's national basketball team|Iceland]] in a three-way tie.

During the 2010s, Andorra always qualified for the final of the Championship for Small Countries, being only beaten by more powerful teams like [[Denmark national basketball team|Denmark]] or [[Armenia national basketball team|Armenia]].
